pr_comments:
IMHO we should not remove link local devices from discovery. There is also not really anything called link local on ipv4, it's auto configured addresses. 

I feel the analysis is wrong on the Bosch thing. Why is it announcing availability on that address if it has no server there.

Edit: ok, the dynamic assigned address on ipv4 have been named link local. I stand corrected on that .

issue_context.title: Bosch SHC "complains" in the log when using HA in a non-internet home
issue_context.body:
### The problem

When using the Bosch Smart Home Hub, it complains the log full of errors while there is DHCP but no internet (this is a remote home with a fine DHCP network, but no internet):

```
 Logger: root
Source: /usr/local/lib/python3.9/site-packages/boschshcpy/api.py:142
First occurred: 19:58:25 (2 occurrences)
Last logged: 20:04:03

    Failed to get public information from SHC controller: HTTPSConnectionPool(host='169.254.204.201', port=8446): Max retries exceeded with url: /smarthome/public/information (Caused by ConnectTimeoutError(<urllib3.connection.HTTPSConnection object at 0x7f93ca5c40>, 'Connection to 169.254.204.201 timed out. (connect timeout=30)'))
    Failed to get public information from SHC controller: HTTPSConnectionPool(host='169.254.204.201', port=8446): Max retries exceeded with url: /smarthome/public/information (Caused by ConnectTimeoutError(<urllib3.connection.HTTPSConnection object at 0x7f934d2910>, 'Connection to 169.254.204.201 timed out. (connect timeout=30)'))
```



### What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2021.9.6

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

Bosch SHC

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/bosch_shc/

### Example YAML snippet

```yaml
Using config flow
```


### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

You are doing a great job!

Would be nice if we could easyly upper or lower the calibration of the temperature of the PPM and/or temp of these Bosch integrations, without doing the whole templating trajectory. Since it's significantly off. But well that is actually a feature request :-)


### Additional information

The "169.254.204.201" suggest the Bosch has no IP, but it does have an IP and works fine. Think 169.254.204.201 is some internal component searching public information from SHC controller or something?
comments:
Hey there @tschamm, mind taking a look at this issue as it has been labeled with an integration (`bosch_shc`) you are listed as a [code owner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L77) for? Thanks!
<sub><sup>(message by CodeOwnersMention)</sup></sub>
@tschamm Is there anything I can do to help solving this issue?
I can confirm this is a bug related to zeroconf discovering devices and providing the respective link local address. I'm working on a fix for this issue.
